measurement: App starts through observed desktop ready, scripted input submission and clean stop. Ready has up to one polling interval of observation delay. No FPS or application render latency assertion.
validation: Six visible App runs completed with matching parameters, no Java fatal exceptions or ANRs, and clean stop. Final ext4 state clean. No concurrent builds or other NCE runs during measurement. One slow run received a three-second host sample after the slowdown was observed.
limits: Same data image and host file cache retained. Ready is observed through log polling; action submission excludes guest rendering completion.
All samples retained. Slow run was additionally sampled; its timing is diagnostic and must be considered separately from clean measurements. Root cause unresolved.
